ground_truth.title: 12 DIY Woodworking Projects
ground_truth.author: Erin Spain
ground_truth.main_content:
Every month I team up with my fellow “DIY Housewives” team of bloggers to bring you posts from each of our archives dedicated to a monthly theme. This month, our theme is DIY woodworking projects, and we are sharing 12 of them to inspire you! Whether you are a beginner woodworker or a seasoned pro, there’s something for everyone.

The project I’m sharing is this DIY Faux Concrete and Gold Leaf planter I built. You can CLICK HERE for the full tutorial.

Be sure to check out the rest of the DIY Housewives’ projects below!
